h1: The 7 Best 85 and 86-Inch TVs of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: the 7 best 85 and 86-inch TVs of 2026, from Samsung and Hisense to LG Nano, commercial 86 inch sets and an outdoor model.
summary: The Hisense 85-inch E6 QLED is our top pick for panel tech, while the Samsung U8000H is the safe brand-name choice. LG's NU85 adds AI Sound Pro, the two LG commercial sets are true 86 inch panels, and the Phonecessity is the only one built for outdoor use.
intro: There is no mainstream 86 inch consumer TV in this pool: the retail world mostly sells 85 inch sets, and 86 inch panels are mostly commercial or specialty. Many buyers shopping for 86 inches are well served by a 85 inch set, since the difference is about one inch.
We ranked seven sets that fit that size class. Two LG models are true 86 inch commercial panels and one outdoor model is also 86 inch. We left out a 75 inch set because it does not match the size.

products.name: Hisense 85" E6 Cinema Series Hi-QLED 4K UHD Smart Fire TV (85E6QF)
products.verdict: The only 85 inch QLED set in this ranking.
products.description:
The E6 is an 85 inch Hi-QLED 4K UHD smart TV running Fire TV, in the $500+ bracket.

It ranks first because QLED is a higher panel tier than the plain 4K sets here. The Samsung and Insignia sets below list no QLED.

Buy it for a living-room cinema. Caveat: the listing is short on other specs.
products.idealFor: Living-room cinema on a big wall.
products.skipIf: You need a true 86 inch panel.

products.name: Samsung 85-Inch Class U8000H Series Crystal UHD
products.description:
The U8000H is an 85 inch Crystal UHD 4K set, in the $500+ bracket.

It ranks second behind the QLED Hisense on panel tier. It is the most familiar brand of the group.

A fit for general viewing. Caveat: no QLED or Mini-LED here.
products.idealFor: General viewing from a trusted brand.

products.name: LG 85-Inch Class Nano AI 4K NU85 Series Smart TV w/AI Sound Pro
products.verdict: Nano panel plus AI Sound Pro audio processing.
products.description:
This is an 85 inch Nano AI 4K smart TV with AI Sound Pro, in the $500+ bracket.

It ranks third because the Nano label sits below QLED, though its audio feature is unique in the group.

Good for movie viewers who skip a soundbar. Caveat: still a modest panel tier.
products.idealFor: Viewers who want better built-in sound.

products.name: INSIGNIA 85" Class F50 Series LED 4K UHD Smart Fire TV with Alexa
products.verdict: Fire TV and Alexa built into a big 4K screen.
products.description:
The F50 is an 85 inch LED 4K UHD set with Fire TV and Alexa, in the $500+ bracket.

It ranks fourth because it is the plain LED option, below the QLED and Nano models. Alexa is the added bonus.

Suits buyers who want voice control. Caveat: the listing names no advanced panel.
products.idealFor: Voice-control fans on a larger screen.

products.name: LG Commercial Lite 86UR340C9UD 86" Smart LED-LCD TV - 4K UHDTV - Navy
products.verdict: A real 86 inch commercial panel at the lowest cost here.
products.description:
The 86UR340C9UD is an 86 inch smart LED-LCD 4K commercial TV in navy, in the $500+ bracket.

It ranks fifth because a commercial set is built for signage more than living rooms. It is the only mainstream true 86 inch set at a lower cost.

Pick it if you need exactly 86 inches. Caveat: commercial features suit offices.

products.name: LG PK340S 86" UHD 4K HDR Commercial TV
products.verdict: An 86 inch commercial set with HDR.
products.description:
The PK340S is an 86 inch UHD 4K HDR commercial TV, in the $500+ bracket.

It ranks sixth because it is aimed at commercial installs and gives few consumer details.

Useful for lobbies and meeting rooms. Caveat: not a home-theater product.

products.name: Phonecessity Weatherproof Outdoor Partial Sun 86" 4K QNED Smart TV L-100 Powered
products.verdict: The only weatherproof 86 inch set, for partial-sun spaces.
products.description:
This is a weatherproof outdoor 86 inch 4K QNED smart TV, listed for partial-sun use. No price bracket appears on the listing.

It ranks last because it is a niche outdoor product, not a general pick.

Buy it for a covered patio. Caveat: check price and install requirements.
products.skipIf: You only need an indoor TV.

methodology.title: Size match
methodology.description: We kept 85 and 86 inch sets and dropped a 75 inch model.

methodology.title: Panel tier
methodology.description: QLED, QNED, Nano and LED were ordered by tier.

methodology.title: Use case

methodology.description: Fire TV, Alexa and AI Sound Pro were noted where listed.

methodology.title: Price bracket
methodology.description: Listed buckets were considered, with missing brackets flagged.

whatMatters.detail: The retail world mostly sells 85 inch panels, while 86 inch ones are mostly commercial. The visible difference is about one inch. Pick by use, not by that inch.
QLED and QNED add color tech beyond a plain LED panel. This affects color vividness. Look for the panel name in the title.
Commercial sets are built for long hours and signage, with fewer home features. Check the listing for words like Commercial.
A screen this size is about 75 inches wide. Measure your wall and doorways, since delivery matters.
An 85 inch 4K set suits about 9 to 12 feet away. Closer shows pixels. Measure your seat.

howToChoose.intro: The use case decides consumer, commercial or outdoor.

cards.label: Consumer
cards.text: Built for living rooms. Hisense E6, Samsung U8000H, LG NU85 and Insignia F50.

cards.label: Commercial
cards.text: Built for signage and offices. LG 86UR340C9UD and LG PK340S.

howToChoose.note: Most buyers should default to a consumer set unless they need exactly 86 inches.

cards.label: Look for
cards.text: A QLED or Nano panel for color and a smart platform you like.

cards.label: In this ranking
cards.text: The Hisense E6 is QLED and the LG NU85 adds AI Sound Pro.

cards.label: Spend more if
cards.text: Picture quality matters. The Hisense E6 QLED is the step up.

cards.label: Save if
cards.text: Size matters more. The LG 86UR340C9UD gives a true 86 inch for less.

faq.q: Is there a true 86 inch consumer TV here?
faq.a: The true 86 inch sets in this ranking are commercial or outdoor. The consumer sets are 85 inch.
Insisting on 86 inches when an 85 inch set is nearly identical in size.

faq.q: Is QLED worth it over standard LED?
faq.a: QLED adds color tech, so it is the step up when picture matters.

faq.q: How do I move an 85 inch TV?
faq.a: Plan for two people and check the box dimensions against your doorways.

faq.q: Can the outdoor TV go in full sun?
faq.a: The listing says partial sun, so full sun is not stated as supported.

faq.q: Do commercial TVs work at home?
faq.a: They work as displays but have fewer home features.

finalTake: For most homes the Hisense 85-inch E6 is the best pick, with the Samsung U8000H as the brand-name safe choice. If you must have exactly 86 inches, take the LG commercial 86UR340C9UD. The outdoor Phonecessity is a niche buy for covered patios.
